pages.title: Tachyon Crystal
pages.text: A crystal grown from hypothetical faster-than-light particles. Tachyons would have imaginary mass, slowing down as they gain energy and never dropping below light speed, and in some frames they would arrive before they left. Holding it, I occasionally feel its weight a moment before I pick it up.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Tachyon Resonator, Cherenkov light passed through a Void Lattice Shard and came out early. Cooling the output in superfluid helium, I caught crystals that existed before I flipped the switch. Bulk monoliths hold a few, inexplicably.
